notes: Cash basis school district; governmental amounts from the Total Governmental Funds column of p4 (Reclassifications column nets the 255,617 General-to-Activity transfer to zero, so top-level transfers_in/out are null). Business-type = School Nutrition proprietary fund (p6; Federal and State subsidies split into state 8,061 and federal 1,223,461 using p20). Reported business-type receipts total is computed (operating 409,999 + nonoperating 1,231,522). Fiscal year ends 2025-08-31. Reconciles: governmental 8,571,418 + 38,616,653 - 39,078,401 = 8,109,670; business-type 461,154 + 1,641,521 - 1,909,413 = 193,262. Debt service 2,111,806 on p4 split into principal 1,468,646 and interest/fees 643,160 from the General and Bond fund schedules. State sources (21,790,630) kept as one line; it includes nameplate capacity tax 1,756 (detail shows it). Detail: General Fund receipts from the detailed schedule pp10-11 and disbursements from the program-by-object schedule pp12-15 (more detailed than the p8 budget-comparison schedule, which is therefore not recorded; its budget columns are not carried). The General Fund transfer to the activity fund (255,617) is printed inside Total disbursements on p15, recorded as other financing -255,617 and the expenditure total marked includes other financing. Activity Fund recorded account by account (pp17-19; receipts, disbursements, and the 5200 Transfers column as signed other financing, net 255,617 = General Fund transfer); the one-line Activity Fund budget schedule (p16) is left out. Student activity receipts total 461,894 on p19 includes 580 Interest (investment income). Student Fee Fund disbursements (1,746) counted as Other support services on p4. QCPU Fund had no activity (budget 2 only). Combined cash balance schedule (p7) and General Fund cash proof (p9) not recorded in detail. Special Building loan repayment 395,625 is printed within Capital outlay on p4. Read pages 1-26 of 26
